Deliberate, portal-wide, and contained: the panel clips it and the document's own sideways-scroll rule is clean at every width. It surfaces HERE and nowhere else only because phone stage 4 (2026-09-22) added the first sweep entry that opens a dialog at all — the same blind spot §10.2 records. Deliberate, portal-wide, and contained: the panel clips it and the document's own sideways-scroll rule is clean at every width. It surfaces HERE and nowhere else only because phone stage 4 (2026-09-22) added the first sweep entry that opens a dialog at all — the same blind spot §10.2 records. Closing it properly means changing `.modalFooter`'s bleed for every sheet in the portal, which is its own piece of work.
